reasoning: As of March 2026, I need to assess whether 2025 global carbon emissions decreased compared to 2024. Historical trends show emissions have generally increased year-over-year, with only rare exceptions during major economic disruptions (2009 financial crisis, 2020 pandemic). In 2024-2025, there was no comparable global disruption. While renewable energy deployment accelerated and some developed nations reduced emissions, developing economies (especially China and India) continued growing fossil fuel use. The IEA and preliminary GCP data typically show continued modest increases. Without a major recession or unprecedented policy shift, a global decrease is unlikely.
